items.title: What is a residential proxy?
items.description: Residential Proxy is an IP address allocated through real home broadband networks, which can simulate ordinary users' online behavior. Compared with data center proxies, residential IP proxies are more difficult to be identified and blocked by target websites, and are the first choice for data collection, web crawling, account registration, ad verification and other scenarios.

items.title: Why use residential proxy IPs?
items.description: Using residential proxy IPs can effectively break through website anti-crawler mechanisms and reduce the risk of being banned. Residential IP proxies have high anonymity and high stability, suitable for cross-border e-commerce, social media operations, market research, SEO monitoring, ad verification and other businesses that require a large number of high-quality IPs.

items.title: What is the difference between static residential proxies and dynamic residential proxies?
items.description: Static Residential Proxy provides long-term unchanged residential IPs, suitable for account maintenance, long-term data collection and other scenarios with high requirements for IP stability. Dynamic Residential Proxy (Rotating Residential Proxy) will regularly change IPs, suitable for large-scale crawling, short-term tasks, anonymous browsing and other flexibility needs.

items.title: What application scenarios are static residential proxies suitable for?
items.description: Static residential proxies are suitable for cross-border e-commerce account maintenance, social media account management, long-term data collection, advertising, brand protection, network security testing and other scenarios with high requirements for IP stability and security. It is also the best choice to prevent account anomalies and improve account security rates.

items.title: What are the billing methods for static residential proxies?
items.description: Common billing methods for static residential proxies include billing by IP quantity, billing by traffic and monthly package. Users can choose the optimal solution according to business needs to achieve cost-effective residential IP proxy services.

items.title: What is the difference between static residential proxies and dynamic residential proxies?
items.description: Static residential proxies provide long-term, unchanged residential IPs, ideal for scenarios requiring high IP stability such as account maintenance and long-term data collection. Dynamic residential proxies (rotating residential proxies) change IPs regularly, making them suitable for large-scale crawling, short-term tasks, anonymous browsing, and other scenarios needing flexibility.
